mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have temperatures near 74 degrees with some slight rain expected near Harriet Park and a Waning Gibbous moon phase.

In city news, September has been proclaimed Hunger Action Month to address food insecurity facing many local residents, plus heads up that flagging on Highway M continues on Monday and Tuesday for utility work which may cause travel delays.
There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

In a look at the weekly report, on August 19, officers handled a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive where drivers were cited for issues including a suspended license and failure to yield.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Crazy for Cookie Dough, before they close at 10 PM.
